note: Authored trash talk (FC10.5): pre-fight and post-fight lines per pair of fighter families, shown as subtitles. Friendly, short, inside every soul's rails; no real person, brand or event. Ink and model lines arrive with M10c.

pre: Two veterans, one floor. Mind your feet.
I have been stepping here longer than your shoes have existed.
Loosen up. This is going to be a long dance.
post: Good floor, good fight. Run it again?
You kept the rhythm. I kept the win.
Next round, the first drink is yours.

pre: Cute lights. Do they come with footwork?
Old school, meet new school. Class is in session.
Let me show you a step that never went viral.
post: Not bad for someone who films everything.
That one is going in my memory, not on a feed.
Teach me your tricks and I will teach you mine.

pre: Is there a plan for this, or just a slide?
I brought a groove. Did you bring a roadmap?
Stand still, I want to see how you move without a screen.
post: Your plan was clean. My feet were cleaner.
Ship that lesson in the next release.
Even a good machine needs a rest. Sit.

pre: Long arms, long stride. Let us see the dance.
Big shoulders do not help you keep time.
I will take the floor, you take the weight.
post: You hit hard. I hit the groove.
Good legs. Need a hand up?
Come back when the beat has moved on.

pre: Two feeds, one ring. Smile for nobody.
Let the crowd pick. They always do.
May the better edit win.
post: That was a cut worth keeping.
Same time next week? I will bring better lighting.
You were great. I will say so out loud.

pre: Do not worry, I will explain it simply.
I will take the poll, you take the patch notes.
Your drones are cute. My crowd is bigger.
post: Fixed in the next version.
The vote is in, and so is the ring.
Your update was fast. My timing was faster.

pre: Pose for the cameras, big one.
I have the crowd. You have the reach.
Do not blink, I swap places fast.
post: You are strong and I am quick. Both matter.
Gumballs and badges, a fair trade.
I will make you look good in the recap.

pre: We both read the same manual. Mine has notes.
Stand back, this is a controlled demo.
May the cleanest patch win.
post: Reproducible result. Thank you.
Your fix was elegant. Mine was in time.
Let us write this up together.

pre: I calculated your reach. It is large.
Plan, then pivot. That is the whole trick.
Please keep your hands where the drones can see them.
post: The plan held. Your shoulders held too.
Strong, honest, predictable. I like it.
Rematch? I will adjust the roadmap.

pre: Two big frames, one small ring.
Gloves are optional. Manners are not.
Warm up first. I want a fair fight.
post: Good fight. Water first, talk later.
You made me earn it.
Shake on it and sit down.

pre: New face. Show me what you have.
Welcome to the floor. Keep it friendly.
Let us see if the stories are true.
post: Good bout. Come back stronger.
You have a future here.
Take a breath. You earned it.

pre: Ready when you are.
Let us make it a good one.
post: Good fight.
Again?
